slides.title: Open Guard Takedown and Escape Game

body.text: The whole trip happens in one round. From a standing or seated start, get it down, get past the legs, and arrive in a pin. Both players get a turn. The bottom player can put the top player down and stand up. The tap is honored the whole way.
This is the whole Descent on the mat, from arrival to the real self revealed.

content.text: Any one of the three stops the round right away. When your partner taps, you stop right then. Not after you finish your move. Stop right away.
